content: We are more easily governed through our vices than through our virtues.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In François de La Rochefoucauld's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
